question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The player was declared __fit and in excellent health__ to play the final matches.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"right as rain"** means in excellent health or perfectly fine. (बिल्कुल ठीक)

 
 
• **Example:** After a good night's sleep, he felt** right as rain** and ready to tackle the day.
 
 
 
• **"Fit and in excellent health"** refers to someone who is in a good physical condition and is healthy. (स्वस्थ और उत्तम स्वास्थ्य में)
 
 
• **Example:** The doctor confirmed that the athlete was **fit and in excellent health** to participate in the marathon.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that "right as rain" is an appropriate substitute for "fit and in excellent health".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Left out in the cold** (ठंड में छोड़ दिया): Ignored or excluded from a group or activity.

 
 
• **Example:** He felt left out in the cold when he wasn't invited to the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Up in the arms** (हाथों में ऊपर): Very angry or upset.
 
 
• **Example:** The community was up in the arms over the proposed construction project.
 
 
 
• **On cloud nine** (नौवें बादल पर): Extremely happy.
 
 
• **Example:** She was on cloud nine after hearing the news of her promotion.
 
 

3e:Tb68,

The correct answer is **Option 2)**
